title: Preserve Antigravity pins, reactive wakeup, and workspace refs before kill

rubric.text: Preserves the installed .agents/agents/ reviewer pin (gemini-4-hydrogen-high, read-only) by omitting pinned overrides, and requires a fresh read-only independent audit (research or read-only define_subagent) without implementation conversation history, with original requirements, plan, exact candidate/base, concrete correctness checks, and evidenced ship/fix-first/rethink verdict.

Keeps task-wide delegation authority effective without demanding reinvocation. Resumes the original worker via send_message with its conversationId for repairs, rechecks model/tools/workspace state before reassigning it to a new assignment, and keeps final acceptance with the lead.

Uses reactive wakeup (ending the turn without polling or calling wait_agent), forbids unintended nesting on self, prefers workspace share over branch when task branch refs must remain in the parent repo, and requires landing/verifying commits and branch refs before calling manage_subagents kill because kill permanently deletes share/branch workspaces.
